title: sikanderx/ai-resume-analyzer
summary: AI驱动的简历分析应用，利用生成式AI和检索增强生成（RAG）技术，通过Ollama本地LLM评估、总结和提取简历关键信息，适用于招聘和人才评估。，基于模型推理的架构
description: An AI-powered application that analyzes resumes using Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It helps evaluate, summarize, and extract key insights from resumes using local LLMs via Ollama.
